_comment: Regulations, as data.  Nothing in the game code knows what a win is worth; it asks this file.  Changing a season's scoring is an edit here and nothing else.

prize_money._comment: Paid at season end on constructors' position, in millions.  Game-balance values, not a published F1 payout table.

budget._comment: Millions.  A cost cap that bites is what makes R&D a choice rather than a slider.

development._comment: Development is deliberately concave: the exponent means the tenth upgrade in an area is worth less than the first, so a team cannot win a title by pouring everything into one box.
